services.name: 1 Hour Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: Our most popular tour is the 20 mile one and a half hour tour. Departing from the Courtyard Marriott, we go north towards Caladesi Island, up to Honeymoon Island and continue on to Three-Rooker Island. blurb: Guests take guided jet ski tours to destinations including Caladesi Island, Honeymoon Island, and Three-Rooker Island, exploring the Gulf of Mexico and intercoastal waterways. Tours include sightseeing, wildlife viewing, beachcombing, and swimming opportunities. Private tours are available for groups, weddings, and birthdays.
extraNote: Notice of cancellation prior to reservation departure time required · In case of inclement weather prior to scheduled departure, offer reschedule up to 1 year or refund · Courtyard Marriott
